description: This file implements a class `Ascii85Decode` that provides functionality to encode and decode ASCII85 (also known as Base85) encoded data, specifically as a filter for PDF processing within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: Ascii85Decode
classes.description: A class that implements the ASCII85 encoding and decoding filters used in PDF processing, inheriting from a base `Filter` class.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into ASCII85 format, returning the encoded byte array with optional padding and proper termination characters.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes an ASCII85-encoded byte array back into its original binary form, handling special characters, padding, and validation.

calls: Math operations for modulo and division
